stations.title: Identify the intended use
stations.purpose: Name who needs the result and what they will do with it.

stations.title: Frame the comparison
stations.purpose: Agree on the quantity to predict and the evidence that would change the Decision.

stations.title: Inspect the available data
stations.purpose: Separate what is available at prediction time from what is known later.

stations.title: Develop a Candidate
stations.purpose: Change a declared part of the Configuration and assess it on dev.

stations.title: Compare and decide
stations.purpose: Read the Comparison and decide what to retain.

stations.title: Held-out pass
stations.purpose: Leave the final measurement to the evaluator.

stations.title: Hand over the result
stations.purpose: Explain how to operate and monitor the retained Configuration.
